relationships.evidence_quote: The Triggering Receptor Expressed on Myeloid Cells 2 (TREM2), in conjunction with DNAX-activating protein 12 (DAP12), regulates microglial activation and immune responses

relationships.subject: TREM2

key_findings: Review: TREM2/DAP12 regulates microglial activation, cytokine release, oxidative stress and neuronal sensitization in neuropathic pain.
